_source: Hisn al-Muslim (Fortress of the Muslim), Sahih al-Bukhari, Sunan al-Tirmidhi

suhoorDua.arabic: وَبِصَوْمِ غَدٍ نَّوَيْتُ مِنْ شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
suhoorDua.transliteration: Wa bisawmi ghadin nawaytu min shahri Ramadan
suhoorDua.english: I intend to keep the fast for tomorrow in the month of Ramadan

iftarDua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي لَكَ صُمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَىٰ رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ ، ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الْأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
iftarDua.transliteration: Allahumma inni laka sumtu, wa bika aamantu, wa 'ala rizqika aftartu. Dhahaba al-dhama'u, wab-tallat al-'urooqu, wa thabata al-ajru in sha Allah
iftarDua.english: O Allah, I fasted for You, believed in You, and broke my fast with Your provision. The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, if Allah wills.

lastTenNights.messageAr: العشر الأواخر من رمضان — أحيوا لياليها
lastTenNights.messageEn: The Last 10 Nights of Ramadan — Seek Laylat al-Qadr

laylatalQadr.arabic: لَيْلَةُ الْقَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِّنْ أَلْفِ شَهْرٍ
laylatalQadr.english: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months

dua.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّكَ عَفُوٌّ تُحِبُّ الْعَفْوَ فَاعْفُ عَنِّي
dua.english: O Allah, You are the Pardoner, You love to pardon, so pardon me

zakatReminder.messageAr: لا تنسَ إخراج زكاة الفطر قبل صلاة العيد
zakatReminder.messageEn: Remember to pay Zakat al-Fitr before Eid prayer

spiritualReminders.arabic: شَهْرُ رَمَضَانَ الَّذِي أُنزِلَ فِيهِ الْقُرْآنُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَبَيِّنَاتٍ مِّنَ الْهُدَىٰ وَالْفُرْقَانِ
spiritualReminders.english: The month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed, a guidance for mankind

spiritualReminders.arabic: مَنْ صَامَ رَمَضَانَ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
spiritualReminders.english: Whoever fasts Ramadan out of faith and seeking reward, his past sins will be forgiven

spiritualReminders.arabic: إِذَا جَاءَ رَمَضَانُ فُتِحَتْ أَبْوَابُ الْجَنَّةِ وَغُلِّقَتْ أَبْوَابُ النَّارِ وَصُفِّدَتِ الشَّيَاطِينُ
spiritualReminders.english: When Ramadan comes, the gates of Paradise are opened, the gates of Hell are closed, and the devils are chained

spiritualReminders.arabic: مَنْ قَامَ لَيْلَةَ الْقَدْرِ إِيمَانًا وَاحْتِسَابًا غُفِرَ لَهُ مَا تَقَدَّمَ مِنْ ذَنْبِهِ
spiritualReminders.english: Whoever stands in prayer on Laylat al-Qadr out of faith and seeking reward, his past sins will be forgiven
